title: Vegetable Man Day celebrates West Virginia cryptid culture
excerpt: He ended by encouraging people to share their creativity and love for cryptids, even if some people think it's crazy.
content:
FAIRMONT, W.Va. (WBOY) — West Virginia is no stranger to tales of supernatural stories and cryptids. To celebrate this aspect of the state's culture, the "Mothboy's Podcast" hosted Vegetable Man Day on the campus of Fairmont State University.

The Vegetable Man is a lesser-known West Virginia cryptid that is native to north central West Virginia. Although the festival is named after the Vegetable Man, organizer Michael Strayer said the festival is celebrating all cryptids.

"Vegetable Man Day is a day to celebrate cryptids, and storytelling, folklore of West Virginia," Strayer said.

Guests at the festival got to enjoy a vendors, cryptid speakers and live music. Strayer said that one of his favorite things about the event is seeing people bond.

"It's all about, you know, everyone just being together" Strayer said. "I guess that's my favorite part is just the togetherness that story telling can bring people,"

He ended by encouraging people to share their creativity and love for cryptids, even if some people think it's crazy.
